definitions.short: a circuit (i.e. district); also a spindle (as whirled); hence, a crutch
definitions.full: H6418. pelek מֶּ֫לֶךְ noun [masculine] 1 whirl of spindle. 2 district (properly circle, circuit ); — absolute ׳פ 2Sam 3:29 , מָּ֑לֶךְ Prov 31:19 ; construct מֶּלֶךְ Neh 3:9 +; suffix מִּלְכּוֺ 3:17 ; — 1 whirl of spindle , 2Sam 3:29 (probably, see Dr), Prov 31:19 (|| כִּישׁוֺר ). 2 district , Neh 3:9 , 12 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 (twice in verse); 3:18 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be round;
